policy.rule: A functional item is PASS only when repository evidence plus an exact-head CI run directly proves the declared behavior. Source-code presence alone is not sufficient for browser/Figma runtime behavior.

capture.reason: The Standard adapter contract is tested, but CI does not yet execute a complete deterministic online/current-document capture acceptance fixture through the required product path.
No exact-head automated browser test currently proves successful file:// capture after explicit extension file-access permission.

LocalFolderProvider tests prove document-relative/root-relative resolution, missing-resource reporting, traversal blocking and remote-reference separation; the source-providers suite passed in CI #825.

Region geometry, clipping, exclusions and precision are tested, but the current real-browser Standard capture harness does not yet directly prove region capture keeps every intersecting node plus required structural ancestors.
Scroll evidence exists in the capture contract, but no real-browser fixture currently exercises both document and primary application scroll-root semantics end to end.

CI #825 runs the final packaged Standard capture adapter in real headless Chrome against the versioned open-ShadowRoot fixture with a named slot and assigned light-DOM node. It proves the shadow host relationship, slot node, source parent, composed-parent remapping, assignedSlotId and editable shadow/slotted text are preserved.

CI #825 runs the final packaged Standard capture adapter in real headless Chrome against the versioned same-origin srcdoc iframe. It proves an accessible child frame and nested document root are captured, the root remains linked to the iframe boundary, editable child-frame text is preserved and no inaccessible-frame diagnostic is emitted.
The STANDARD_CAPTURE_FRAME_INACCESSIBLE contract is present, but no real-browser cross-origin fixture currently proves the diagnostic/fallback behavior.
No automated runtime artifact currently proves capture freezes the current visual state and restores the page without permanent mutation.

Real headless Chrome/CDP evidence from CI #764 executes the packaged content script and proves cancel and confirm both restore scroll, focus and inline scroll behavior and remove the selector overlay. CI #825 reruns the permanent browser runtime harness successfully.

packageAcceptance.reason: Packager tests prove deterministic .wtf ZIP bytes, manifest/checksums, required payload paths, traversal rejection and canonical JSON; the relevant suites passed in CI #825.
Parser hostile-fixture tests pass and the UI performs parseWtfPackage before enabling renderer handoff. The parser suite reran successfully in CI #825.

CI #798 proves final .wtf export fails closed unless the capture-profile-required reference ground truth is complete. CI #825 reruns the Standard and High Fidelity NODE-14/NODE-21 package validators successfully.

importAcceptance.reason: The choose-file event path and intake descriptor are implemented, but no DOM-level UI interaction test currently exercises the complete choose flow.
Canvas drop intake is implemented, but no Figma-runtime integration test currently exercises an actual drop event through secure parse and render.
The UI disables import until parseWtfPackage succeeds, parser hostile fixtures pass, and renderer handoff consumes only currentParsed validated content.
The renderer creates W2F_IMPORTING_ROOT_NAME, marks transactionState importing, then commits after the plan is applied; the behavior is covered by tests.
Injected adapter mutation failure proves the temporary root is removed; the plugin also removes renderedRoot if later hybrid/visual/layout stages fail.
Renderer tests prove semantic names are preserved and blank names receive deterministic useful fallback names.
Tests prove stable source IDs, revision hashes, source tag/selector and document/revision identities are persisted in pluginData.
Capability resolver tests prove native/wrapper/absolute/emulated/raster/unsupported decisions and stable reasons; renderer pluginData preserves render strategy metadata.
Section defaults/normalization and selected-root subtree rendering are directly covered by tests.
Commit calls adapter.setSelection([root]) and adapter.focusNodes([root]); tests assert both calls and the Figma adapter maps them to currentPage.selection and viewport.scrollAndZoomIntoView.

fontAcceptance.reason: CI #781 proves the product renderer uses a deterministic case-insensitive exact family/style decision before any fallback, and the dedicated five-test policy suite verifies exact matches are reported without substitution.
CI #781 proves same-family Regular/nearest/default resolution is explicit and every editable TextNode persists requested-to-chosen font mappings plus reason, count and truncation state in pluginData.
Correction is an allowed strategy, but no tested end-to-end policy currently proves geometry-preserving correction is attempted or validated before a different fallback strategy.

No dedicated policy test currently proves text cannot be rasterized solely to hide missing-font/substitution errors and that raster text is used only when the fidelity profile explicitly justifies it.
